messages:
lina_k: Heads-up — after last night's RBAC prune + netpol tighten we got a customer report: decryption requests are sometimes succeeding but audit events are missing. tagging @rachel_c and @tom_s.
sec-bot: alert: priv-kms-proxy: decrypt_fallback_detected instance=priv-edge-07 fallback=local-keystore audit_emitted=false
lina_k: Repro (canary): apply strict netpol, then simulate KMS latency, see proxy log: 
```
2025-02-10T02:41:11Z ERROR kms-proxy: upstream KMS timeout=4502ms -> using local keystore
2025-02-10T02:41:12Z DEBUG audit: forward failed: http 403 forbidden
2025-02-10T02:41:12Z INFO  kms-proxy: decrypt ok (fallback=true)
```
rachel_c: 403 from audit API? that implies auth problem, not netpol. Which SA is used by proxy?
tom_s: proxy runs as `system:serviceaccount:priv:priv-kms-sa`. We did run the clusterrole-binding cleanup that removed `priv-audit-full` binding last night. Might be related.
lina_k: also worth noting netpol was tightened to deny egress except to metrics/logging endpoints — could block audit-forwarder reachability too. We need to triage both RBAC and netpol.
devops-bot: runbook hint: priv-deploy-audit preflight exists: `scripts/priv/audit_preflight.sh` (but not part of the canary gate).
tom_s: quick triage steps I ran: `kubectl auth can-i create events.audit.redwood.io --as=system:serviceaccount:priv:priv-kms-sa -n priv` -> "no". So RBAC missing. Also curl from proxy pod to `logging.priv.redwood.local:9000` succeeds in canary after we temporarily opened netpol. So both were risky.
rachel_c: mitigation plan (short): 1) apply a namespace-scoped Role that allows create on audit.events and bind to priv-kms-sa, 2) patch proxy to fall back to local append-only audit file when forward fails, 3) add netpol exception for audit-forwarder egress in private clusters.
lina_k: Tom, can you paste the Role YAML you'll apply?
tom_s: role blob: 
```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: audit-writer
  namespace: priv
rules:
- apiGroups: ["audit.redwood.io"]
  resources: ["events"]
  verbs: ["create"]
```
will bind to `system:serviceaccount:priv:priv-kms-sa`.
rachel_c: short-term patch applied to canary. I also added a lightweight file-backup in proxy: on POST fail write JSON line to `/var/log/priv/audit-queue.log` with append-only perms.
lina_k: good. Compliance asked for timeline and evidence. Please create an incident and collect the logs.
sec-bot: incident created: INC-2025-47 severity=medium reporter=lina_k window=02:30-03:10UTC
oncall-ops: any outage or data exposure?
rachel_c: no data exposure — decrypt still succeeded locally. The risk is missing audit records during fallback. Customer-facing SLA unaffected but compliance gap exists.
tom_s: root causes: 1) RBAC prune removed a needed binding, 2) netpol tighten risked connectivity to audit sink, 3) proxy didn't persist audit when forward failed. Also found a client lib issue: `go-audit-client v2.0.1` would swallow 403s and not return the payload for retry. Opening vuln-triage.
lina_k: action owners: Tom -> role + netpol patch (canary in 30m). Rachel -> proxy fallback file + small retry queue PR. I'll own incident doc + notify compliance. Devs: please add automated preflight that runs `kubectl auth can-i` for all audit-related SAs and a netpol connectivity check.
tom_s: applied RBAC to canary and validated `kubectl auth can-i` -> yes. Netpol exception added scoped to podSelector `app=audit-forwarder` and dst port 9000; marked with expiry annotation.
rachel_c: PR for proxy queue up: https://git.internal/redwood/kms-proxy/pull/892 (adds disk queue + drain thread + unit tests). Includes e2e that simulates sink 503/403/timeout.
sec-bot: compliance checklist updated: priv-audit-forwarding -> degraded -> mitigation_in_progress.
oncall-ops: monitoring: added alert `priv_audit_forward_failures > 0` and runbook link. Also added Prom rule for `conntrack` if we see increased NAT churn when netpols are tightened.
lina_k: longer-term proposals: - require explicit namespace-scoped RBAC for forwarders (no reliance on clusterrolebind pruning). - add `preflight` gating for private deploys that runs RBAC + netpol checks. - harden proxy client to do token-refresh-before-retry and persistent queue. Add these to the private-deploy hardening RFC.
tom_s: opening RFC wedge: `rfc/priv-deploy-audit-hardening.md`. Will include automation design for RBAC drift detection.
rachel_c: next steps: finish PR review, cut minor release to canary tomorrow, and run a compliance replay job that drains the disk-queued audit events to the sink and verifies ordering.
lina_k: thank you. Please keep the incident timeline updated and ping legal/compliance if a customer requests evidence. Closing thread once INC-2025-47 is resolved. :white_check_mark:
